purpose: Three staff rune texture masks, not icons or runtime preview

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: original greyscale rune texture mask for a realistic fantasy staff, matching the craft quality of ornate sword engravings. A single extremely narrow vertical continuous composition, 5:1 height to width, centered on pure solid black background, portrait canvas. Entire motif visible with black margins. The actual art occupies only the central roughly 28 percent of image width and 88 percent of height. White to light grey solid engraved strokes on black, hard crisp silhouettes, refined tapering line weights, a few controlled worn hairline breaks, smooth calligraphic edges. Predominantly medium weight strokes with detailed internal negative space that remain readable at game scale. One larger main seal in the upper third, an asymmetrical flowing spine linking distinct secondary gestures below, a fine tapered ending. This is a flat 2D mask, no metal object, no staff, no frame, no labels, no letters, no text, no lighting, no shadows, no glow, no gradient background, no repeated tiled icons. Intricate but disciplined handcrafted fantasy runic design. Theme EAGLE EYE: the main seal is an abstract sharp watchful eye with a narrow pupil framed by swept eagle feather blades, sophisticated avian clarity, not a realistic bird face. Descending spine contains two unequal feather/arrowhead flourishes, open etched arcs, tiny angular tick marks and a very fine sighting spear point at the bottom. Quiet, precise, elegant, varied spacing. Four or five distinct masses, generous black negative space.
